name: Homelab-ressurs-alarmer
description: Webhook mottar Prometheus/Alertmanager-alarmer og sender leser vennlig varsel til telefon

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify((() => { const b = $json.body || {}; const a = b.alerts || []; if (!a.length && b.attachments) { const at = b.attachments[0] || {}; return { title: at.title || 'NetAlertX', message: String(at.text || b.text || '').slice(0, 700) }; } if (!a.length) { return { title: 'Homelab-varsel', message: JSON.stringify(b) }; } const f = a[0]; const resolved = b.status === 'resolved'; const name = (f.labels && (f.labels.name || f.labels.alertname)) || 'tjeneste'; const summary = (f.annotations && f.annotations.summary) || ('Alarm: ' + name); const desc = (f.annotations && f.annotations.description) || ''; return { title: (resolved ? '[LØST] ' : '[ALARM] ') + summary,          message: (desc || summary) + (b.status ? ' (' + b.status + ')' : '') }; })())
